text: Harvest timing (ការប្រមូលផល). Harvest timing should balance the crop's natural growth cycle against market demand. Pulling radish before it is fully mature results in yield loss and roots that cannot be stored well (they are still too tender/immature). Delaying harvest too long, letting the radish become overly mature, can also reduce yield and quality. Recommended readiness indicators: leaf color shifts from light/young green to a darker, more mature green; the growing crown/tip firms up and stops elongating; and the root itself fills out and changes from a pale, immature color to a fully developed one. Once these signs appear together, the crop is ready to harvest.
